White House moves to curb aircraft import reliance

•	The White House says Commerce found the U.S. aircraft industry is too reliant on foreign supply chains.

•	Trump is directing Commerce and USTR to negotiate agreements with trading partners.

•	The goal is to address the “threatened impairment” of national security.

•	The move targets commercial aircraft, jet engines, and aircraft and engine parts.

Lutnick pushes Samsung and SK Hynix to expand U.S. memory output

•	Howard Lutnick called on Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix to speed up U.S. memory-chip expansion to help relieve AI-related shortages.

•	He said he is discussing the issue with both companies but did not give details.

•	Lutnick framed the move as a way to make the U.S. chip supply chain more resilient.

•	He acknowledged Micron may not like rival expansion, but said broader U.S. capacity is the priority.

Why it matters: Memory, especially HBM, is a critical bottleneck for AI hardware, so more U.S. production would be a big supply-chain win.

Israel shares intel on fresh Iranian plan to kill Trump, signaling escalation risk -WSJ

•	Israel shared new intelligence with the U.S. on Iran. 

•	Intel indicated a fresh Iranian plan to kill President Trump. 

•	Israeli embassy in Washington declined to comment. 

Trump’s Public Comments on Threats 

•	Speaking in Ankara, Turkey, Trump alluded to threats against his life. 

•	“They want to take out the U.S. leader—me,” he said. 

•	Said “I’m on every list… every single one of their lists.” 

•	Added he has been “a little bit lucky” so far. 

•	Trump and Netanyahu spoke Thursday, per Israeli PM’s office. 

•	Statement said they agreed to continue “coordination between the countries.” 

•	Trump updated Netanyahu on recent U.S. activity in the Gulf.

$GRAB plans a 15x expansion of Vietnam’s EV charging network

•	Grab plans to grow its Vietnam EV charging network from about 400 ports today to over 6,000 by early 2028.

•	Nearly half of the new ports will be located in Hanoi, backed by a Memorandum of Understanding signed with the city in late June.

•	The push offers a brand-neutral alternative to VinFast’s proprietary charging system.

•	Grab’s Electric Vehicle Utility feature, launched in April, already connects drivers to 400+ ports from providers like Eboost, Charge+, EV One, and ChargeLink.

•	More than 7 in 10 driver partners who try the feature return to use it again within 7 days.

Why it matters: A brand-agnostic charging network could accelerate EV adoption among ride-hail drivers in Vietnam without locking them into a single carmaker’s ecosystem.
